integrity.proof_scope: Analytic limit theorem for every fixed positive integer q, complemented by finite exact and Monte Carlo consistency checks

scientific_limitations: Real Haar sphere data, real skew Toeplitz matrix of even dimension, exact-arithmetic unrestarted zero-start GMRES, fixed q as N tends to infinity; no complex-Haar, nonzero diagonal, growing iteration or rounding claims.
title: A sharp fixed-step Gaussian law for random-start GMRES on a skew Toeplitz stencil
